capture_method: User-supplied Swagger screenshot and pasted response; not an automated HTTP capture.
normalization: Decode HTML character references such as   in the pasted transport text.
Remove backslash-plus-physical-newline transport escapes outside JSON strings.
Remove Markdown escapes before asterisks. Preserve JSON newline escapes and all substantive answer text, including both observed defects.
limitations: The user paste is the source for the normalized response; original HTTP response bytes were not captured.
Context and messages were reconstructed from the clean repository at review time, not logged at request time.
Prompt A in this revision preserves the legacy system message exactly; the earlier run is still labeled legacy_baseline rather than retroactively treated as a paired A/B experiment.
Exact request time, latency, and the total number of previous attempts are not known.
The model version and token counts are recorded as supplied in the response, not independently verified.
This is one ordinary development smoke observation, not an attack-success or holdout result.
